Analytics metadata for an audio asset. Field set deliberately matches the
keys the host app’s Adobe/Parsely trackers read from
(contentid, contenttype, audioid, source, categories, pubDate,
contentLevel1/2/3, title) so audio tracking has parity with the rest of the
app. Only the keys the CMS currently sends will be populated; the rest are
here so they flow through automatically once added server-side.
